description: Ask the Keeper about the project (like `pk ask`). Returns what is already organized at once, and an investigation job id; call again with jobId to fetch its answer. Read-only toward the project; the investigation uses the owner's model key.

cwd.description: A folder inside the project. Default: the folder the server was started in.

jobId.description: An investigation job id from an earlier ask: fetches its answer.

port.description: Workbench port. Default: the one in ProjectKeeper's settings (4870).

project.description: Project id (`pk projects` lists them). Default: the project containing cwd.

question.description: The question. Not needed with jobId.

thread.description: Keep asking in this thread (from an earlier ask).

name: projectkeeper_ask
